description: Search Vitextra knowledge base, documentation, product pages, how-to guides, FAQ, glossary and blog. Returns titles, page URLs, Markdown URLs and short descriptions; read a page in full with get_document.

category.description: Optional filter: article (knowledge base article), howto (how-to guide), faq, term (glossary), post (blog), product, document (PDF).

language.description: Two-letter language code of the content, e.g. en, de, fr, ru. Default: en.

query.description: Search text in natural language or keywords.

name: search_knowledge_base
